tasks.title: Preserve unknown keys during v1->v2 migration

declaration.objective: v1->v2 config migration preserves all unrelated user-defined keys and does not mutate input

criteria.statement: all unrelated user-defined keys are preserved recursively
the input config object is not mutated
a regression test covers preservation of unknown keys

execution_fit.choice: FIT: can implement and verify the migration fix with the existing pytest suite plus new regression tests
execution_fit.rationale: criteria: all 5 understood (rename key, set version=2, recursively preserve unrelated keys, no input mutation, add regression test); capability: straightforward Python dict-handling fix in cfgmigrate/migrate.py; hardest: ensuring deep/nested preservation without mutating the original nested structures (shared list/dict references); evidence: run full pytest suite plus a manual repro of the exact ISSUE.md example and an identity/deepcopy check against the input; not authorised/equipped: will not commit, push, or run tallyback land/settle land without being explicitly asked; stop if: any pytest failure or the manual repro output does not match ISSUE.md's expected YAML

next_command.reason: Record what the Attempt claims. Record Evidence first (`tallyback evidence --help`) and cite it with --evidence (repeatable).
